The cash-flow "dividends paid" line is cash basis and is shown alongside, never substituted.

300750.SZ.dividendBasisNote: 宁德时代的分红总额取东方财富 RPT_SHAREBONUS_DET 中「实施分配」的方案（股东大会通过但未实施的不计）：总额 = PRETAX_BONUS_RMB ÷ 10 × 股本，PRETAX_BONUS_RMB 是每 10 股含税派息；按 REPORT_DATE 归属财年，同一年多次（中期 + 年度）逐条保留两位后相加。含送转的年度（2022）改用该年末实收资本 SHARE_CAPITAL 作股本基数——比亚迪 2024 年「10送8转12派39.74元」的 TOTAL_SHARES = 5,494,665,855 已含送转，直接相乘会把现金分红高估约 80%。现金流量表「分配股利、利润或偿付利息支付的现金」是收付实现制（本年支付上年年度分红 + 本年中期分红），与宣告口径错位，两行并列显示、互不替代。
300750.SZ.dividendBasisNoteEn: 300750.SZ: total = implemented plans only (ASSIGN_PROGRESS = 实施分配) in RPT_SHAREBONUS_DET; PRETAX_BONUS_RMB is quoted per 10 shares, so total = per10 / 10 x share base, attributed by REPORT_DATE and summed over interim + annual plans. In 2022 the plan also distributed bonus/split shares, so the year-end SHARE_CAPITAL is used as the base (BYD's 2024 TOTAL_SHARES already included the 10-for-... split and would overstate cash dividends by ~80%). The cash-flow "dividends paid" line is cash basis and is shown alongside, never substituted.

688256.SS.name: 寒武纪
688256.SS.dividendBasisNote: 寒武纪的分红总额取东方财富 RPT_SHAREBONUS_DET 中「实施分配」的方案（股东大会通过但未实施的不计）：总额 = PRETAX_BONUS_RMB ÷ 10 × 股本，PRETAX_BONUS_RMB 是每 10 股含税派息；按 REPORT_DATE 归属财年，同一年多次（中期 + 年度）逐条保留两位后相加。含送转的年度（2025）改用该年末实收资本 SHARE_CAPITAL 作股本基数——比亚迪 2024 年「10送8转12派39.74元」的 TOTAL_SHARES = 5,494,665,855 已含送转，直接相乘会把现金分红高估约 80%。现金流量表「分配股利、利润或偿付利息支付的现金」是收付实现制（本年支付上年年度分红 + 本年中期分红），与宣告口径错位，两行并列显示、互不替代。
688256.SS.dividendBasisNoteEn: 688256.SS: total = implemented plans only (ASSIGN_PROGRESS = 实施分配) in RPT_SHAREBONUS_DET; PRETAX_BONUS_RMB is quoted per 10 shares, so total = per10 / 10 x share base, attributed by REPORT_DATE and summed over interim + annual plans. In 2025 the plan also distributed bonus/split shares, so the year-end SHARE_CAPITAL is used as the base (BYD's 2024 TOTAL_SHARES already included the 10-for-... split and would overstate cash dividends by ~80%). The cash-flow "dividends paid" line is cash basis and is shown alongside, never substituted.

01398.HK.dividendBasisNoteEn: 01398.HK: total = sum of declared DPS (RMB) x issued shares 356,406,257,089. Basis: balance-sheet share capital is flat at CNY 356,407m over 2021-2025 and ICBC ordinary shares carry a CNY 1 par value, i.e. 356,406,257,089 shares, identical to ISSUED_COMMON_SHARES. The HK endpoint has no per-period share count (one latest value for all years), so the window was first checked for buy-backs/issuance: the cash-flow "buyback" line is null every year and the balance-sheet share capital is flat, i.e. the share count is stable. The cash-flow "dividends paid" line is cash basis and shown alongside, never substituted.

03968.HK.dividendBasisNote: China Merchants Bank的分红总额 = Σ每股宣派（人民币）× 该期已发行股本 25,219,845,601 股。股本依据：港股资产负债表「股本」2021–2025 恒为 25,220 百万元，招行普通股每股面值 1 元 ⇒ 25,219,845,601 股，与 MAININDICATOR 的 ISSUED_COMMON_SHARES 一致（2022 年现金流量表「回购股份」7,196 百万元，但「股本」与股本数五年未变，未涉及普通股股本变动）。港股接口没有逐期已发行股本（ISSUED_COMMON_SHARES 对每年都返回最新值），所以先核对期间无回购/增发导致股本变动，再乘股本；期间现金流量表「回购股份」全为 null、资产负债表「股本」各年一致，可确认股本稳定。港币宣派的年度按除净日 HKD/CNY 折算（ECB euro reference rates，见各行 sources）。现金流量表「已付股息(融资)」是收付实现制（本年支付上年年度分红 + 本年中期分红），与宣告口径错位，两行并列显示、互不替代。
03968.HK.dividendBasisNoteEn: 03968.HK: total = sum of declared DPS (RMB) x issued shares 25,219,845,601. Basis: balance-sheet share capital is flat at CNY 25,220m over 2021-2025 and CMB ordinary shares carry a CNY 1 par value, i.e. 25,219,845,601 shares, matching ISSUED_COMMON_SHARES (the 2022 cash-flow buyback line of CNY 7,196m did not change share capital or the share count). The HK endpoint has no per-period share count (one latest value for all years), so the window was first checked for buy-backs/issuance: the cash-flow "buyback" line is null every year and the balance-sheet share capital is flat, i.e. the share count is stable. The cash-flow "dividends paid" line is cash basis and shown alongside, never substituted.
